title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to Visit Tamil Nadu on October 30
body_text: The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Tamil Nadu on October 30, 2026. During his visit, the Vice-President will pay his respects and offer floral tributes at Pasumpon, Ramanathapuram, on the occasion of Pasumpon Muthuramalinga Thevar Jayanthi. He will also attend the Golden Jubilee Celebrations and the 39th Convocation Ceremony of Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University) in Dindigul. *** PR/ASM/VM
